text:
laura (secops): quick heads-up — during an offline KMS failover test on the EU on‑prem cluster we observed the edge agent allow cached creds to be used and make external egress connections. looks like a fail-open behavior. :warning:
raj (infra): can you paste the minimal repro/logs? which agent + version?
laura (secops): agent v2.7.1. sequence: primary KMS unreachable -> agent switched to local keystore fallback -> cache TTL exceeded but requests still allowed -> telemetry call to telemetry.prod.redwood.example:443 seen. log snippet: 
```
2025-08-14T09:12:03Z agent auth: KMS unreachable (timeout)
2025-08-14T09:12:04Z agent auth: using local-keystore fallback (ttl=3600)
2025-08-14T09:16:11Z agent session: token reused beyond ttl
2025-08-14T09:16:11Z agent egress: CONNECT telemetry.prod.redwood.example:443 -> 10.1.2.3:443
```
kim (eng-sre): thanks. immediate action: cordon + drain the node and kill the agent process, then block egress from the agent namespace while we triage. can someone apply a temporary NetworkPolicy? sample to deny all egress except to KMS IPs: 
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-except-kms
  namespace: edge-agent
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.2.0.0/24 # KMS subnet
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
maria (platform): also we should restrict the agent SA RBAC — it currently has broad secrets/get on namespace. propose patch to remove secrets:list and restrict to specific secret names. e.g.: 
`kubectl auth reconcile -f agent-sa-limited.yaml`
owen (privacy): audit logging concern — we need immutable forward to SIEM for these events. please ensure pod-level audit is shipped to syslog and retention set to 90d. also we should rotate KMS grants and revoke any long-lived local keystore entries.
laura (secops): triage checklist I'm running now: 1) cordon node (kubectl cordon edge-node-3) 2) drain pods from node w/o deleting data 3) kill agent (systemctl stop redwood-edge-agent) 4) remove local-keystore files from /var/lib/redwood/keystore/* 5) trigger KMS rotate + revoke grants: `aws-kms rotate-key --key-id arn:... --force-rotate` (internal tool) 6) force session token invalidation via service: `redwoodctl sessions invalidate --filter agent=edge` 7) apply networkpolicy fail-closed and deploy updated agent config (fail_closed: true) 8) escalate to legal if telemetry data crossed boundary (owen).
raj (infra): agreed. i'll apply the netpol and cordon node now. what's the approved KMS IP range for onprem?
maria (platform): KMS endpoints are restricted to 10.2.0.0/24 and 10.2.1.0/24. i'll push a constrainedServiceAccount policy for the agent SA and open a PR for CI to enforce it.
kim (eng-sre): follow-up: we should change the default fallback to be fail-closed in agent 2.8.0 and add an explicit env var REDWOOD_AGENT_FAIL_CLOSED=true. also add e2e test that simulates k8s network partition + KMS failure.
laura (secops): incident response timeline so far: detect 09:12 -> isolate 09:18 -> revoke keys 09:28 -> still validating data exfil flags 09:35. document everything in the incident tracker.
owen (privacy): if telemetry PII was included we need to trigger breach assessment. laura please capture list of telemetry recipients and TTL of cached tokens.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for hotfix branch: edge-agent-2.7.1-failopen-patch -> staging (CI checks started). :lock:
maria (platform): postmortem items: - tighten SA permissions - enforce netpol templates for onprem clusters - require KMS healthchecks in bootstrap - immutable audit forwarding - add KMS offline drills in runbooks
kim (eng-sre): i'll own the netpol + e2e tests. raj will coordinate node remediation. laura please own the incident writeup and compliance notification.
laura (secops): thanks everyone. i'll open the incident doc and ping legal/privacy if needed. follow-up meeting in 30m. :thumbsup:
